"BORING SIMPLE STRENGTH"
Bill Starr Tribute
Day:15 Tuesday 10-15-24

Warm Up: Take a couple minutes and
learn about Bill Starr. 5 x 5

1. BACK SQUAT
5 reps @ 67%, 70%, 73%, 75%, 77%
2 to 2½ min rest between sets

2. BENCH PRESS 5 sets of 5 reps
same %'s as the above squats
same rest

3. BB BENT OVER ROWS 5 sets of 5 reps
2 min rest

Cardio
DB RDL's
5 sets of 5 reps
2 min rest between sets

Recovery
Chicken Casserole
extra helping
30 min walk
8-9 hrs sleep

"Day 15: Boring Simple Strength"
Warm up: Take a couple minutes and learn about Bill Starr. 5 x 5
1. Back Squat 5,5,5,5,5 reps @ 67%, 70%, 73%, 75%, 77%
rest 2:30
2. Bench Press 5,5,5,5,5 reps @ 67%, 70%, 73%, 75%, 77%
* same rest as the above squats
rest 2:30
3. BB Bent Over Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
rest 2:00
4. DB RDL's 5 sets of 5 reps
rest 2:00
Recovery: Chicken Casserole · extra helping · 30 min walk · 8-9 hrs sleep
